text = "Maria Chen joined Northwind Freight, a company in Chicago."
found = tt.recognize(text, kinds=["person", "organization", "place"],
    relations={"works_for": ("person", "organization"),
               "based_in": ("organization", "place")})
for name in found.entities:
    print(name.id, name.text, name.kind)
# 1 Maria Chen person
# 2 Northwind Freight organization
# 3 Chicago place
for link in found.relations:
    print(link.name, link.source, link.target)
# works_for 1 2
# based_in 2 3
